name: Kanon
description: Tags anime episodes as canon, mixed or filler from Anime Filler List, skips filler through media segments, and builds no-filler playlists. Fork of Ronin by ahza-code.

versions.changelog: FillerLists as a filler source: Naruto, Shippuden, One Piece, Bleach, Dragon Ball and other long-running series are matched by id and classified from FillerLists, with Anime Filler List for everything else (setting: Filler data source). Original titles are tried when matching, for non-English servers. Badges now work on servers with a base URL.

Anime libraries: tick libraries in Kanon's settings and every series in them is treated as anime, whatever its genres and tags. For Shoko, AniDB and similar libraries that don't use an Anime genre or tag.

First Kanon release: tags anime episodes as canon, mixed or filler from Anime Filler List; skips filler via media segments and by removing it from the web player's queue; builds no-filler playlists. Built for Jellyfin 12.4. Fork of Ronin by ahza-code.
